changes: First library release, for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74 on core-ar2 0.3. The FILTER page's FRQ popup shows the cutoff in hertz, from 13.8Hz to 21.1kHz, instead of 0 to 127.

Tested by the author on a unit as FZ74 (the released core-ar2 0.3 and Filter Hz alone): FRQ readings, RES unchanged and a minute of playback with samples and delay and reverb sends on all tracks. Modwerk's source-only package, linked by the vendored kit, gives FZ74's .syx byte for byte.
